about: Add a sponsored person to ICP's administrative list through a circular.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Circular on a sponsored person (administrative list). Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Open to citizens, residents, GCC citizens and government or private entities and free zones
Complete any changes ICP asks for if the application is returned
documents: A MOHRE letter where a circular is issued before the work card is cancelled
fees: Financial guarantee 2,000 AED and deposit 20 AED
channels: ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
